why: DMN 1.6 Table 67, time offset: "The time offset duration must be in the interval [duration(“-PT14H”)..duration(“PT14H”)] as per the XML Schema Part 2 dateTime datatype." time(hour, minute, second, offset) takes every offset of whole seconds in that interval. A duration with a fraction of a second is no time offset (XML Schema Part 2 §3.2.7.3: "Timezones are durations with (integer-valued) hour and minute properties") and gives null instead of being truncated; whole seconds are kept, as the DMN TCK requires for time(11, 59, 45, duration("PT2H45M55S")).
